title: Umthwalo Wesipho Esenqatshiwe
intro: Ekuqaleni komlando wesintu, lapho umhlaba usemusha futhi umhlaba ubambe umoya wawo wokuqala, umphefumulo wema phambi koMdali nomnikelo othobekile. Lowo mnikelo walinganiswa esilinganisweni sokwamukelwa kwaphezulu - futhi watholakala untula. Okwalandela kwakungeyona indaba yokuthethelela, kodwa yenhliziyo egcwele umona, okwaholela esenzweni esingenakuguqulwa esasizohlala sikhona. Lena indaba yomuntu ogama lakhe lahlotshaniswa nokungabi nabulungisa kokuqala okukhulu okwake kwenziwa.
clues: Ngazalwa njengomunye wabantwana bokuqala ukuzalwa, ngazalwa ngumzali oyazi kahle indaba yakhe.
Ngake nganikela umhlatshelo ku-Allah, kodwa awuzange wamukelwe yimi — yize umnikelo womfowethu wamukelwa ngomusa.
Umona nentukuthelo kwagxila enhliziyweni yami, futhi ngasongela ukuqeda impilo yezihlobo zami.
Umfowethu wangixwayisa ukuthi ngesabe u-Allah, kodwa ukuqhosha kwami ​​​​kwakungavumi ukuthi ngilalele.
Ngesikhathi sobuthakathaka obukhulu, ngenza isenzo esingenakuchazeka kumfowethu.
Ngemva kwalokho, angizange ngazi nokuthi ngingakufihla kanjani engangikwenzile — kwaze kwaba yilapho kuthunyelwa isidalwa somhlaba ukuzongifundisa.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
